purpose: Accumulate genuinely prospective, immutable evidence for ticker, direction, accumulation, surge, topping, target, timing and risk-control claims.
backfill_policy: Forecast and outcome creation timestamps must be within 300 seconds of wall-clock time; historical backfill is rejected.
required_before_forecast: decision timestamp and data cutoff timestamp
feature, data and code SHA-256 hashes
entry/target/invalidation when the component claims them
claim_boundary: Meeting the count gate only opens human proof review. It never grants capital automatically.
